tei:div.tei:p: gnas bdag chen po'i gsol mchod 'dod don lhun grub bzhugs// raṃ yaṃ khaṃ/ 'khor 'das chos kun gdod nas stong pa'i ngang*// rten 'byung 'gags med sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i gar// dngos 'byor yid sprul kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin// mkha' khyab yul skyong mnyes pa'i rdzas su gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum/ /rang mdun srid zhi'i 'byor pas mngon mtho'i dbus// rgyal dbang pad+ma'i bka' nyan gnas bdag che// phyogs las rnam rgyal rdo rje kun grags rtsal// dkar gsal gzhon mdzes ru dar me long 'dzin// dar dkar zhwa gos rta dkar rlung gshog chibs// sras yum blon 'khor bran g.yog pho nya'i tshogs// sde brgyad dregs pa'i dpung dang bcas pas bskor// gar bzhugs gnas nas 'khor bcas spyan drangs gyur/ kyai/ 'bri klung gser ldan nor 'dzin yangs pa'i khyon// lha mi'i dpal 'byor phun tshogs sbas yul gyi// gzhi bdag chen po phyogs las rnam par rgyal// rab 'byams dpung gis tshogs bcas gshegs su (452)gsol/ bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri bā ra badz+ra sa ma dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ ho tiṣ+ṭha lhan// dngos bshams yid kyis rnam par 'phrul pa yis// dgyes rgu'i longs spyod zad med nam mkha'i mdzod// rab 'byams kun tu bzang po'i mchod pa'i sprin// chos kyi dbyings kun rgyas par bkang te 'bul/ bhu mi pa ti sa pā ri bā ra ar+ghaṃ= shab+ta ma hā pū dza pra tits+tsha ho/ bza' bca' ldag gzhib 'dod yon lha mo'i sprin// dbang shes zag med bde ster gtor ma'i tshogs// sna tshogs bzang shing bsregs pa'i dud sprin las/ rnam mang mchod tshogs mkha' dbyings khyab par 'bul/ ma hā ba liṃ ta dhu pe pū dza ho/ nyer spyod 'dod yon bkra shis rdzas rtags brgyad// rgyal srid sna bdun rta drel 'dod 'jo'i ba// g.yag lug ra dang ri g.yung gzugs 'gros tshogs// mkho dgu'i 'byor pa rgya mtshos thugs dam bskang*// bdag cag mi shes 'khrul pa'i dbang gyur pas// phog thug 'gram 'khrugs 'gal 'khrul nyes pa'i tshogs// mi dmigs klong yangs ngang du mthol (453)bshags na// byang dag tshangs pa'i dngos grub deng 'dir stsol// chos kyi dbyings las sgyu ma'i rol par bzhengs// sna tshogs tshul gyis 'gro ba srid las sgrol// sa chen la gnas rgyal sras sems dpa' che// byang chub lam gyi grogs su mnga' gsol lo// rgyal ba'i bstan skyong rnal 'byor dgra lha che// mthu rtsal thogs med dam nyams bstan dgra'i gshed// srid gsum dbang mdzad phya g.yang 'dod rgu'i ster/

lha chen phyogs las rnam rgyal khyod la bstod// gsang chen bstan pa'i rgyal mtshan phyogs bcur sgreng*// bdag cag 'gal rkyen kun zhi mthun rkyen sgrubs// 'jig rten pa kun phan bde'i dpal la sbyor// phyogs dus kun tu bkra shis khyab gyur cig ces pa'ang dharma hastis bris pa dge/ ༈ kyai/ tshangs pa rdo rje dkar po bsang*// kong po rdo rje dpal brtsegs= phywa lha tshangs pa dkar po= gnyen dong rdo rje dgra 'dul bsang*// po pho rdo rje gzhon nu= smri ti rdo rje ye shes= rog po rdo rje phur bu= tsha (454)ba'i rdo rje dgra 'dul bsang*/ gnyen po rdo rje zil phrom= gnas po rdo rje gur mgon= smra mol rdo rje ngang dkar bsang*/ bod kyi ri dbang spun dgu rnams// 'dod yon rgya mtsho'i mchod pas brngan// rgyal ba'i bstan pa dar zhing rgyas// bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i bzhed don sgrubs// mtha' dmag dus 'khrugs mi phyugs nad// sad ser btsa' than zhi ba dang*// rtogs ldan dpal 'byor g.yang du len// bkra shis bde legs phun tshogs mdzod/ zhes dpal chen 'dus pas so/// / dge'o//
